governance.note: pjm-71 recipe verbatim (CAMPD historic unit-outage windows, measured monthly delivered gas + PJM zonal basis, coal PRB/BIT passthrough sigmoids with BIT floor 0.65, per-plant CAMPD must-run/committed tranches, retiree CEMS availability envelope, measured EIA-930 monthly hydro + 2024 backfill, EIA-860 BTM + 2024 backfill, priced interchange at measured reference-bus prices with per-seam p90 tie caps, energy+reserve co-opt on the measured PJM reserve requirement, reliability floor) with exactly two offer-curve changes, both derived from PJM Manual 15 structure BEFORE the solve, not bisected on any residual: (1) CC_REGULAR econ_low 0.92 -> 1.00 — the LP carries no no-load/start-cost variable, so Manual 15 total-cost recovery (no-load + incremental) requires every tranche to offer at >= 1.0x full-load AHR fuel cost; the inherited 0.92 was an uncited 'pjm-58 level' (docs/parameter-citations.md marks it needs-citation). (2) CT_PEAKER econ_high 1.40 -> 1.27 — Manual 15 Section 2.3 caps the cost-based offer adder at 10%; worst-tranche CT IHR ~1.15x class AHR gives a cost-cap ceiling ~1.27x; 1.40 exceeded what a cost-capped CT can offer. CC committed left at 1.00 and the CT peak block left untouched (scarcity/tail proxy pending the per-gen reserve co-opt build, docs/multi-iso/pjm-reserve-ordc.md Phase 1-2 gate). No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no adder/haircut applied to a price or volume residual; no input rescaled so model output lands on actuals.
governance.residuals_note: Predicted signs stated in the driver docstring before solving and confirmed: CC down ~-4.4 TWh in ALL years (year-uniform, as a multiplier move must be), CT up +1.0..+1.8, coal_bit up ~+1.3, mid-merit prices up. 2024 CC_REGULAR +20.9 -> +16.5 TWh and CT_PEAKER -9.7 -> -8.8 TWh (improved, still C1 FAIL); 2025 CC +4.9 -> +0.3; 2023 CC -2.3 -> -6.7 TWh (new C1 volume fail: the uniform step trades 2023 against 2024). The 2024-concentrated CC-over/CT-under imbalance is NOT reachable by year-uniform offer multipliers — the residual root cause is the missing commitment tightening / per-gen reserve structure (docs/handoffs/pjm-cc-overgen-recommendation-2026-06.md Rank 1/2; docs/multi-iso/pjm-reserve-ordc.md Phases 1-2). Both Manual-15-grounded corrections stay in per CLAUDE.md rule #1 (a structurally-correct offer level is not reverted because a residual moved); the 2023 worsening is documented as the cost of removing a below-cost offer band that was silently compensating for the missing commitment structure.
